states.unreviewed: No type-specific audit has been recorded for this profile, position and path.
states.inspected: Implementation was read; this is not an executed test.
states.passed: The named check passed for the recorded scope and artifact.
states.limited: The check covers only the explicitly recorded subset.
states.rejected: The path explicitly rejects this shape. Required delivery remains outstanding.

copied.ownership: Copied values have no retained Lean identity. Host-owned buffers may require a generated cleanup function.
copied.absence: No implicit null, omission or default conversion. Unit, Option, optional parameters and host null are separate cases.
copied.failure: Reject invalid host values before calling Lean. Preserve declared errors and unexpected-failure policy.

identity.ownership: Preserve nominal identity, runtime and generation. Generate borrow, lease, transfer and deterministic disposal from the declared lifetime.
identity.absence: A missing or disposed resource is not a null value. Optional identity values require an explicit Option mapping.
identity.failure: Reject stale, wrong-kind and wrong-runtime values. Cleanup must also run on callback re-entry and failure.

signature.ownership: Preserve every argument and result ownership transition, including cleanup after rejection or cancellation.
signature.absence: Keep parameter omission, declared defaults, Option.none and host null distinct.
signature.failure: Preserve declared errors, effect order and delivery protocol; reject unsupported signatures before producing a release.

erased.ownership: Proof-only values have no host allocation or handle.
erased.absence: Erasure is determined by elaborated Lean types, not by substituting null for an unknown type.
erased.failure: Keep runtime refinement checks and theorem provenance even when proof arguments are erased.

shapes.bounds: One inhabitant. A result with no host return value still requires an explicit argument and field mapping.
Exactly two Boolean values; do not coerce numbers or strings.
0..255; reject overflow before narrowing.
0..65535; reject overflow before narrowing.
0..4294967295, including on hosts with 32-bit signed integers.
0..18446744073709551615; no conversion through a floating-point host number.
-128..127; reject overflow before narrowing.
-32768..32767; reject overflow before narrowing.
-2147483648..2147483647; reject overflow before narrowing.
No fixed bit-width limit. Reject negative inputs and enforce documented allocation limits.
Preserve sign and magnitude without narrowing; enforce documented allocation limits.
Round to binary32. Specify NaN, infinities and signed zero; do not claim NaN payload preservation without a bit-level test.
Preserve binary64 values, NaN classification, infinities and signed zero.
Preserve Unicode scalar values and embedded NUL. Reject invalid encodings; declare byte and allocation limits.
Each byte is 0..255. Preserve zero bytes and owned result storage; declare copy limits.

shapes.meaning: An ordered, finite sequence of values.
shapes.bounds: Validate every element recursively, length and allocation limits. Array UInt32 alone does not cover Array α.
Keep none, some unit and nested options distinct; do not flatten them all to null.

shapes.meaning: A success value or a declared error value.
shapes.bounds: Preserve the success/error branch and both payload types. Lower Except ε α to IR result arguments [α, ε], in success/error order.

shapes.meaning: A fixed ordered product of values.
shapes.bounds: Preserve arity, nesting and per-position types; do not infer tuples from arbitrary arrays.

shapes.meaning: A named copied product with declared fields.
shapes.bounds: Preserve every field and mutability rule. A Payload example is not evidence for arbitrary records.

shapes.meaning: A named reference to another semantic type.
shapes.bounds: Resolve aliases without losing constraints, identity or ownership; reject alias cycles.

shapes.meaning: One named constructor with its typed fields.
shapes.bounds: Preserve constructor identity and payloads without exposing Lean constructor numbers.

shapes.meaning: A nominal value retained in the shared runtime.
shapes.bounds: Preserve cross-component identity and explicit disposal; reject stale or foreign resources.

shapes.meaning: A host callable with a declared signature and lifetime.
shapes.bounds: Preserve argument/result types, re-entry, invocation count, self-disposal and errors.
Preserve order and elements without exposing list constructors; choose and test a lossless IR lowering.
0..0x10FFFF excluding 0xD800..0xDFFF; not one UTF-16 code unit or an arbitrary string.
Bind width to the compiled Lean target, not the consumer process; reject out-of-range values.
Bind signed width to the compiled Lean target and record architecture explicitly.

shapes.meaning: A natural value strictly below a bound.
shapes.bounds: Keep the bound and validate it before erasing proof fields. Fin 0 has no constructible value.

shapes.meaning: A value satisfying a Lean predicate.
shapes.bounds: Generate a checked constructor when validation is executable; require explicit decisions for non-decidable predicates.

shapes.meaning: A runtime type or constraint depends on an earlier value.
shapes.bounds: Preserve the dependency through a checked lowering or a reviewed exclusion; never discard it as an implicit argument.
Bound nesting and allocation; reject host cycles unless the declared identity model supports them.

shapes.meaning: Exports parameterized by types or instances.
shapes.bounds: Deliver checked finite specializations; record open-generic gaps without using an untyped transport.
Separate erased type arguments from implicit runtime values; resolve them from elaborated information.
Specialize or supply the selected dictionary without changing runtime behavior.

shapes.meaning: Proof-only declarations and arguments are erased at runtime.
shapes.bounds: Record theorem identity and assumptions. Erasure does not remove the need to check a runtime refinement.

shapes.meaning: A callable permits an omitted argument.
shapes.bounds: Apply only the declared default; distinguish omitted input from a supplied Option.none.

shapes.meaning: Null from a declared host API.
shapes.bounds: Select an explicit host projection; null does not stand for every missing, erased or unsupported value.

shapes.meaning: A Lean action with IO effects and IO errors.
shapes.bounds: Executing IO is not automatically asynchronous. Preserve effect order and exceptions.

shapes.meaning: An effectful action with a declared error type.
shapes.bounds: Preserve typed failures separately from transport validation and unexpected traps.
Project every declared error and payload; preserve trap or poisoned-runtime handling separately.

shapes.meaning: A computation whose result arrives later.
shapes.bounds: Keep completion, rejection, cancellation and runtime lifetime distinct; do not block a browser event loop.

shapes.meaning: An identity-bearing object owned by the host.
shapes.bounds: Generate typed members and preserve receiver identity, dynamic-access policy and lifetime.

shapes.lean: Lean function returned to the host
shapes.meaning: A retained Lean closure callable through a generated host API.
shapes.bounds: Preserve captured state, call signature, errors and deterministic disposal.

shapes.meaning: A declared request to stop pending work.
shapes.bounds: Specify acknowledgement and late completion; release pending work exactly once.

shapes.meaning: A sequence delivered by explicit pulls.
shapes.bounds: Preserve values, end-of-sequence, failure, early return and cleanup.

shapes.meaning: A sequence whose individual pulls can complete later.
shapes.bounds: Preserve backpressure, pending-pull cancellation and terminal cleanup.
